subject: Onboarding & Offboarding Evidence — consolidated timeline and artifacts
messages:
From: Claire Mills <claire.mills@auditspring.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Supply Team <supply@oakbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: consolidated onboarding/offboarding timeline + evidence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of Oakbank's SIG review we need a consolidated packet showing how Redwood handles employee onboarding (training, background checks) and offboarding (access revocation, asset return) for the 24-month sampling window. Specifically: 

- A human-readable timeline of the typical onboarding workflow (key checkpoints and owners).
- Sample training completion logs for hires in 2025–2026 (redacted PII OK).
- Evidence of background check completion and redaction index.
- Audit trail showing access revocation on offboarded users (at least three records).

Can you send a single package or link with the files and a short narrative to help the reviewer? Ideally by EOD Friday (2026-12-10) so Oakbank can finalize their SIG submission.

Appreciate it,
Claire Mills
Senior Assurance Manager
Auditspring

--
Attachment: request-guidance.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Mills <claire.mills@auditspring.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated onboarding/offboarding timeline + evidence

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan:

1) Kimberly will pull the redacted background index and chain-of-custody manifest from HR/vendor exports.
2) Marissa will extract training completion logs and the sampling metadata.
3) Soojin will generate the offboard access revocation PDF from our IAM audit logs.
4) I'll assemble a 1-page narrative timeline and put everything into a single Drive folder plus a signed manifest.

We can meet a short status check tomorrow if needed; otherwise expect the package by EOD 2026-12-10. If Oakbank needs anything earlier (specific user samples), flag the names and we'll prioritize.

Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

--
Bcc: (none)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated onboarding/offboarding timeline + evidence — HR exports attached

Jordan,

Attached are the HR vendor exports and my notes:

- background-check-index-redacted.csv (attached) — contains vendor reference ID, hire date, check type, redaction token; names/emails redacted per policy.
- chain-of-custody-manifest-2026-12-07.txt (attached) — lists who accessed the PII export, timestamps, and the S3 object IDs.

Notes: in two cases (candidates onboarded 2024-11 and 2025-02) the vendor initially returned an inconsistency and we re-verified — those records are annotated in the index with vendor_recheck=TRUE.

Flag for Marissa: training logs will need the sampling filter (we're including hires with role tags: engineer, infra, support).

Kimberly Park
HR Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: background-check-index-redacted.csv, chain-of-custody-manifest-2026-12-07.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated onboarding/offboarding timeline + evidence — training & revocations

Jordan / team,

I've exported the training completions (onboarding-training-logs-2024-2026.csv) and created a short narrative file inside the Drive folder: "onboard-offboard-narrative.txt" summarizing the workflow and owners. Key points to call out for Claire/Oakbank:

- Mandatory security & data handling training required within first 7 days; completion gates block certain privileges in PAM until confirmed.
- Background checks are kicked by HR via HireFast; completion is required before privileged access is provisioned.
- Offboarding triggers automated IAM revocation + manual device reclamation. Audit log samples attached show IAM revoke events with correlating ticket IDs.

Soojin: offboard access PDF is in my Drafts folder for review (offboard-access-revocations-2026-06-30.pdf).

I'll assemble index.csv references and confirm the Drive share settings are set to "view-only with download" and that the manifest contains MD5 checksums.

Marissa Cole
Security Controls Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding-training-logs-2024-2026.csv, onboard-offboard-narrative.txt

From: Claire Mills <claire.mills@auditspring.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Supply Team <supply@oakbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated onboarding/offboarding timeline + evidence — received

Jordan, Kimberly, Marissa, Soojin —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear package. I reviewed the Drive items and the narrative; a few minor follow-ups before Oakbank closes the SIG:

- Can you add a short line in the narrative describing how we spot-verify vendor rechecks (the two annotated rechecks).
- Please include one export row (redacted) that maps the HireFast vendor ID to our internal onboarding ticket ID — just the mapping row is enough for traceability.
- Confirm the manifest hashes (MD5) were generated after redaction.

If you can drop those in the same folder by EOD Monday (2026-12-13) we should be good. Appreciate the responsiveness — will loop back if Oakbank needs anything else.

Best,
Claire Mills
Senior Assurance Manager
Auditspring
